title: A price list with photos
description: One print format on the Price List: each general price of the list with the item's photo, read through ivn_rows and ivn_value with the rights of the person printing (POS build 2.0.0.654 on). A print sent from the e-mail queue shows no rows.

print_formats.name: PP PLR Price List with Photos
print_formats.html:
{#- The price list with photos — a print format on the Price List itself (POS build 2.0.0.654 on). It lists the list's own prices through ivn_rows and each item's photo through ivn_value, with the rights of the person printing: a person who may not read a price or an item sees fewer rows, and a print sent from the e-mail queue shows none. General prices only (no customer's or batch's own price). Up to 1,000 prices, read 200 at a time, in item code order. -#}
{{ doc.price_list_name }}
{{ doc.currency }}{% if doc.selling %} · selling{% endif %}{% if doc.buying %} · buying{% endif %}
{%- for start in [0, 200, 400, 600, 800] %} {%- for r in ivn_rows("Item Price", filters={"price_list": doc.name, "customer": ["is", "not set"], "batch_no": ["is", "not set"]}, fields=["item_code", "item_name", "price_list_rate", "uom"], order_by="item_code asc", limit=200, start=start) %} {%- set photo = ivn_value("Item", name=r.item_code, field="image") %} {%- endfor %} {%- endfor %}
